item_short_desc: Rothco’s BDU Replacement Buttons offer a convenient and durable solution for replacing worn or lost buttons on BDU pants, shirts, and jackets. Crafted from high-quality plastic, these buttons are designed to withstand the demands of frequent wear and washing. The classic 4-hole layout makes them easy to sew, and the versatile design complements a range of garments. Each bag includes 100 buttons, providing ample replacements for BDU-style gear.
